ns2:course.label: Intro to Ag & Leadership Ed
ns2:course.description: Overview of agricultural and leadership education career pathways in school and non-school settings, including extension, corporate and government sectors, and international and industry organizations. Includes overview of certification requirements, professional development, and current issues for agricultural education professionals.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Agric Leadership & Sci Educ major(s). Not intended for students with Junior or Senior class standing.
